name: Warm Slice of Famous Boysenberry Pie (Seed/Sugar Warning)
whyItWorks: Whole boysenberries contain thousands of tiny hard seeds suspended in sweet fruit filling inside a flaky lard/shortening crust. These seeds act as abrasive particles that can get lodged in inflamed pockets or narrowings.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Seed & Stricture Warning: Strictly avoid if you have intestinal strictures or active Crohn's. In remission, eat filling with seeds strained out.
